detail.longDescription:
Zapia is the AI assistant that gets things done for you. Your personal assistant powered by artificial intelligence automates your WhatsApp, organizes your calendar, answers your email, sets reminders, manages your tasks, and compares prices. All the power of advanced AI, easy to use and secure. No setup needed.

Just chat or send a voice note.

Over 10 million people already use Zapia as their AI assistant.

AI ASSISTANT FOR WHATSAPP
Automate your WhatsApp with AI: summarize chats, schedule messages and replies, and transcribe your voice notes to text. Zapia messages businesses, vendors, and restaurants for you to get quotes, book, or negotiate. Find any of your contacts and send them a message just by asking. You can also mention Zapia with @zapia right from WhatsApp.

CALENDAR, SCHEDULE & REMINDERS
Your schedule, always in order. Ask "what's on my calendar tomorrow?" and you're set. Create, view, and edit Google Calendar events with a message or a voice note. Set one-time or recurring reminders: appointment reminders, bill reminders, birthday reminders, or anything you need. Zapia is also your daily planner: every morning you get a summary of your calendar plus weather, news, and price alerts, and your assistant tells you what is on today and what to prepare.

EMAIL
Read and summarize your Gmail or Outlook inbox. Ask "summarize today's email" and get what matters in seconds. Your AI assistant drafts and sends each email for you, replies to your messages, and notifies meeting participants of changes or delays. The reply is ready and you decide whether it gets sent.

TASKS & TO-DO LISTS
Organize your tasks with a message: create to-do lists, add tasks, and get reminders so nothing slips. Schedule automated tasks and Zapia handles them end to end, in the background. More productivity at work and in your personal life.

VOICE NOTES
Prefer to talk? Send your AI assistant a voice note and it sets reminders, adds calendar events, replies to email, or creates tasks. Zapia also transcribes the voice notes you receive.

BUILD YOUR TEAM OF AI AGENTS
Add an AI agent for every area of your life, no code and no complex setup:
• Finance Agent: tracks spending, budgets, and alerts
• WhatsApp Agent: automates messages and contacts
• Nutrition Agent: meal plans and tracking
• Travel Agent, Shopping Agent, and many more
Each AI agent works for you in the background.

PRICES & SHOPPING
Compare prices across your favorite stores. Track products and get alerts when prices drop. Build lists and carts in your favorite shopping and delivery apps.

RESTAURANTS & TRAVEL
Find the best restaurants near you and book a table at your favorite spots. Search flights, compare prices across platforms, and plan your trip end to end.

WEBSITES FOR YOUR BUSINESS
Create your business website in minutes: send your photos and prices, and Zapia builds and publishes your page.

ASK, WRITE, TRANSLATE & SUMMARIZE
Ask your artificial intelligence assistant any question and get an answer right away. Zapia helps you write, translate, summarize PDFs and documents, analyze photos, and transcribe voice notes. It responds in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, and learns your preferences.

RADAR
Zapia works in the background and keeps an eye on your email, calendar, and WhatsApp. Radar stays ahead and proactively alerts you to things you might be missing, before you even ask.

CONNECT YOUR APPS
Connect your favorite apps with our official connectors, or ask Zapia to connect the services you use: WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Outlook, Telegram, and any other app you use day to day. Your email, calendar, contacts, and tasks in a single chat.

WHY CHOOSE ZAPIA
• A personal AI assistant that acts, not just answers
• Calendar, reminders, email, tasks, and contacts in one place
• Works by chat or voice notes, no setup needed
• Advanced artificial intelligence that is easy to use and secure
• Free to start and in your language
